**Fresh (last 24–72h)**
- **Samsung shipped the industry-first 12-layer HBM4E samples (May 29)** — first to market on HBM4E; pushing for NVIDIA's H2-2026 16-Hi orders. Bullish memory. (DCD / TrendForce)
- Otherwise quiet: no new 24–72h DRAM/HBM contract-price print or capex guidance.

## Context (vs baseline thesis)
- **Hyperscaler capex tracking ABOVE baseline** — Q1-2026 prints put big-5 2026 AI capex ~$725B (MSFT ~$190B, AMZN ~$200B, GOOGL $175–185B) vs the $600–700B baseline.
- **DRAM Q2-2026 +58–63% QoQ, NAND +70–75%**, extending into Q3/Q4. HBM4 ~mid-$500s/stack; all three makers' 2026 HBM sold out.
- **SK Hynix US IPO** window June–July 2026 (~$10–14B) — a supply-cycle/sentiment marker to watch.

## Signals flashing
- HBM4/4E transition — accelerating — bull
- Hyperscaler capex — revised up vs baseline — bull
- "Correction after 2026" — not yet visible, still latent — watch

## Most important
Samsung's first 12-layer HBM4E samples (May 29) — the HBM4E race started ahead of schedule, reinforcing the memory leadership fight and a pull-forward of the supercycle.

*Not investment advice. Forward figures are forecasts.*
